name: Camel Pose
description: Kneeling backbend reaching the hands back toward the heels.

source.title: Yoga Journal Pose Library
source.note: Stick-figure approximation. Twists and binds can't be fully shown in 2D.

setup: Kneel with your knees hip-width apart and your thighs upright; tuck your toes under if you like.
Put your hands on your lower back, fingers pointing down.

keyframes.name: Kneel tall
keyframes.cue: Kneel with the hips over the knees.

keyframes.name: Camel Pose
keyframes.cue: Lift the chest, arch back, and reach for the heels.

cues: Keep the hips over the knees.
Lift the chest before reaching back.
